# statuspal-next_services (Data Source)

Lists the services on a status page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "statuspal-next_services" "acme" {
  status_page_subdomain = "acme-status"
}

output "service_slugs" {
  value = [for s in data.statuspal-next_services.acme.services : s.slug]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `status_page_subdomain` (String) Subdomain of the status page whose services to list.

### Read-Only

- `services` (Attributes List) Services on the status page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services))
